body: Merged main to resolve conflicts (mod.rs, job.rs, generate.rs: keep both sides). Targeted gate: 3 chamfer_open_refusals tests, 10 chamfer_circular tests, 5 chamfer_open_edges tests, and clippy passed. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).

**Verdict: Needs changes before merge - not built, read-only review.**

## What looks good

- The refusal stays visible. `simple()` raises `GenError::Empty` only when fewer than two points remain (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/contour_run_side.rs:107`), and a non-finite point raises `Invalid` and passes through unchanged. The new message is therefore accurate for every mapped case. No silent pass path is added.
- The guard comment at `crates/motion/src/machining2d/chamfer.rs:233` matches item 2 of issue #3086: the check is kept as a documented guard, and its `else` arm still refuses. No panic.
- Test placement is correct: `crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs` imports only `camcraft_motion`, and lives in the crate that provides it. Coverage does not shrink: two tests move with their assertions, and one new test pins the collapse case and asserts the word "centerline" is gone.
- File sizes are under the limit: `chamfer.rs` 274 lines, `chamfer_circular.rs` 350, the new file 96. No goldens, no new dependencies, no process files, no `build.rs` / `.github` / scripts changes.
- The commit subject is conventional, the body ends `Fixes #3086`, and `Changelog: none` is correct: the feature is not released yet, so the row belongs to #3059's change.
- The new string obeys ASD-STE100: "a chamfer edge collapses to one point - re-pick the edge". Short, active, one instruction.

## Results

Not built: read-only review (fork PR; this review builds it neither locally nor on the runner). The contributor reports the targeted gate green on this head: 3 `chamfer_open_refusals` tests, 10 `chamfer_circular` tests, 5 `chamfer_open_edges` tests, and clippy (PR comment, 2026-11-21). Clippy risk from the test move is nil: `chamfer_circular.rs` still uses `chamfer_open_runs` and `rect` elsewhere.

Heavy lanes: not run in this review. The change maps an error string and moves tests; it cannot change a coordinate or posted output.

## Requested before merge

1. **Fix the stacking state.** The body says "stacked on #3059", but the base is `main` and this head contains #3059's unmerged commits (`4e22c8dbe`, `2fbe6f2fb`). `gh pr diff 3115` shows 9 files, including the whole `feat(chamfer)` from #3059. AGENTS.md ("Overlapping issues stack") puts the parent first: retarget this PR to `issue/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains` (`gh pr edit 3115 --base issue/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains`). Its diff then shrinks to your one fix commit. When #3059 merges, take `git merge origin/main`, and this PR returns for a re-check. Merging it as it stands now would land a `feat` (P6) in `main` ahead of the cut. See also: #3059 carries `conflicts` and needs its own refresh first.
2. **Add the Gate map line** to the new file's header, as the sibling suites have, for example: `//! Gate map: covers camcraft_motion::machining2d (chamfer, open-run refusals).` (`crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs:1-6`; AGENTS.md "Testing", and `chamfer_circular.rs:8` shows the form.)

## Notes (not blocking)

- An empty inner run (`vec![vec![]]`) also gets "collapses to one point", although it holds zero points. The wording is close enough; the refusal and the fix instruction are correct.
- `rect()` and `chamfer_params()` are now duplicated in the two test binaries. That is normal for integration tests; a shared module would need `tests/common`. No change asked.

After change 1 the code itself needs no other work. A clean re-check at the rebased head should make this PR merge-ready; the coordinator merges clean-reviewed fork PRs.

Addressed the review findings at head  621a7af1:

1. **Gate map line added:** Added //! Gate map: covers camcraft_motion::machining2d (chamfer, open-run refusals). to crates/motion/tests/chamfer_open_refusals.rs. CodeRabbit review passed with 0 findings, and the test suite passes.
2. **Stacking base note:** Attempted to retarget via gh pr edit 3115 --base issue/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains. GitHub rejected the command because issue/2988-chamfer-open-edge-chains exists in the contributor fork paulrobin/Camcraft and is not a branch in NeoTech/Camcraft. A cross-fork PR base cannot target a branch outside the target repository. Once parent PR #3059 merges into main, this PR's diff against main will automatically reduce to the #3086 fix commit alone.

**What to do instead:** wait for #3059 to merge to `main`. Then run `git merge origin/main` on `issue/3086-chamfer-open-refusal`, and push. The diff will then show only your own chamfer-refusal work. Then comment here for a re-check.

The label `needs-rework` stays. No action is needed from you until #3059 merges.
